steps.note: HaX's line: Quintero is named wrongly and sent back; naming Arakawa while she is out is refused ('Get Quintero back first'); 'Bring Quintero back' recalls her. Arakawa is then named wrongly and recalled the same way.

said: Quintero leads on the ground. If you're wrong, nobody's at your back at the end.
Agent Quintero, come back up to the post. Now, please.
I took the drain. I didn't pack the case. Read the sheet.
Agent Quintero, you are cleared. Go back down.
Next time, read the sheet first.
notSaid: Arakawa holds the county for us.

said: Arakawa holds the county for us. If you're wrong, the sheriff starts asking questions.
Officer Arakawa, back to the post. The county will have to manage without you.
You were standing right next to me. Think.
Officer Arakawa, you are cleared. Back to it.
You heard me on the phone to her. Then you thought I'd do this?
